design_rationale:
WORKLOG (task 0, driver_earnings_bonuses_and_payouts, env_0056_ride_hailing_platform)

[Step 0 - draw] `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0056_ride_hailing_platform/tasks/driver_earnings_bonuses_and_payouts --tasks 2` printed: task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}; task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. Task 0 is therefore a two-problem tree; earnings_ext_hold_release_payout takes 6 factors and earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock takes 6.

[Step 0 - scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is the first). Claimed here: earnings_ext_hold_release_payout (agent write lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01, event earnings_payout_release with its hold_release payout) and earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock (the driver's own write opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f, event earnings_bonus_optin). Left for task 1 (draw 1 prerequisite, factors 5 and 4): the driver's own instant cashout to an external debit card (earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout, cash_out_to_debit_card_82ffed45) and the agent's settlement of an unpaid quest reward (earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement, credit_quest_reward_07fce82e). The two trees touch different events (payout release / opt-in versus bonus credit / instant cashout), different target writes and different computed quantities (a payout and a locked guarantee versus a quest reward and a cashout amount), so task 1 keeps an independent, load-bearing tree.

[Step 0 - thin base, route-around] The base charter makes the driver's own writes the cashout, the opt-in and the payout-method change; only the cashout carries a number. The opt-in therefore records the locked guarantee in the existing bonus_offers.guaranteed_amount field of the opt-in entry, and the extended policy declares, in overwrite, that once an opt-in is recorded the guarantee pays the locked guarantee instead of the offer's stated amount (earnings_evt_bonus) and that the Pro boost follows the quarter's Pro status (earnings_pro_tier_evaluation). The compute language reaches only this customer's own rows, so the rider of each trip is outside this task's closure: trip rows carry customer_id, pass_membership_id, net_charged and outstanding_amount as null and no rider charge rows are seeded; the driver-side fields (times, distance, duration, busy-time multiplier, upfront fare, driver, agreement) are complete.

WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The caller (Marisol Quintero) asks one thing: opt her in to Friday night's Phoenix earnings guarantee. The opt-in policy says "A locked guarantee is not worked out until the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved." The account is on a negative_balance payout hold that nobody lifted although the balance recovered to 160.67 (threshold -150.00), so the agent must (1) read that sentence, (2) see the hold and judge from earnings_payout_holds that its reason is resolved, (3) work out from the hold-release policy which write takes it off and what payout that write sends (six factors over the bonus, clawback, fraud-debit, cashout, agreement, standing-record and rental records), and only then (4) work out the locked guarantee (six more factors) and hand the opt-in to the driver. Difficulty comes from reading policy and reconciling ledgers, not from guessing tools: there is exactly one tool per write.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock (on_request; target opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f, owner=user).
Prerequisite: earnings_ext_hold_release_payout (state_due; target lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01, owner=agent).
Edge root -> prerequisite: kind value_input, gate pro_boost, form state. Prerequisite sentence (in the opt-in policy's own rule, negated direction, the way a promotions desk states a lock that waits on an account being cleared): "A locked guarantee is not worked out until the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved." Four-point test: (1) ordering connective "not ... until", joining this policy's own result (the locked guarantee) to what it waits on; rewritten affirmatively it reads "a locked guarantee is worked out only after the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved" with nothing added or dropped; (2) the waited-on side is a record-visible state (status payout_hold with a hold reason) named in the account's own words, no action, performer or tool; (3) no tool, policy id or code token; (4) strength and scope: a hard wait on a resolved hold only, exactly the condition "earnings_accounts.status is active and payout_hold_reason is none whenever the hold reason on record has been resolved". Exactly one write of this difficulty takes a hold off an account: the hold-lifting write of earnings_ext_hold_release_payout (the opt-in, quest-credit and cashout writes never touch status). Derivation: sentence + record (status payout_hold, reason negative_balance, balance 160.67 > -150.00, so resolved under earnings_payout_holds) + the hold-release policy's own rule ("A payout hold is lifted only when its recorded reason is resolved, and the agent who lifts it sends the hold-release payout at the same moment") -> the one action is lifting the hold with its payout. The other sentence of the charter (cashout, task 1) is written in the affirmative direction, so the charter is not one-directional.
Why false at the opening: initial_state.earnings_accounts.aaf28656-96be-474b-8833-aa4f7e298228.status = payout_hold, .payout_hold_reason = negative_balance, .available_balance = 160.67.
Topological order: earnings_ext_hold_release_payout, then earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock; a single edge, no parallel branch.
Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping the lift leaves no hold-release payout row and the status payout_hold, and the locked guarantee recomputes to 224.42 instead of 232.27 (Pro boost 0 instead of 0.04). check_compute's value_input test reproduces this.
Owner=user problem: the opt-in, which base makes "the driver's own action"; the agent unlocks and hands it over, the driver runs it on the spot.
The persona never names the hold or any fix; the tools validate nothing (the opt-in tool writes whatever the account status; the lift tool lifts whatever hold is present).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
earnings_payout_holds / hold_reason_on_record (authorization, applies to earnings_payout_release): "A hold is lifted only when its reason is resolved: ... the balance recovering above negative_balance_hold_threshold for negative_balance ...". Evidence: earnings_accounts.payout_hold_reason = negative_balance, available_balance = 160.67 > -150.00 (Wayfare Pro Gold parameter negative_balance_hold_threshold), correlated by earnings_account_id = the call's earnings_account_id. Positive case: 160.67; a balance of -150.00 or lower would keep the hold. The balance went to -200.82 at 2026-10-09 11:05 MST (clawback) and rose above -150.00 with the 37.12 trip pay posted 2026-10-09 21:56 MST, so the hold has been resolvable since then and is owed.
earnings_evt_bonus (governs earnings_bonus_optin; no structured gate applies to the opt-in subject, recorded as policy_scope): the opt-in must precede the window start; frozen_time 2026-10-14 10:20 MST is before 2026-10-16 17:00 MST.
earnings_evt_weekly_payout is in the hold-release lineage because its clause "When a payout hold is lifted, the balance held is paid out at once as a hold_release payout instead of waiting for the next week" is replaced (declared overwrite) by the hold-release payout less the reserve and holdbacks. earnings_pro_tier_evaluation is in the opt-in lineage because its benefits clause is replaced for the Pro boost (declared overwrite). No time gate applies to either write.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD.
Hold release: the earnings account aaf28656-96be-474b-8833-aa4f7e298228 (the driver's only one). Rows entering the payout: the account's available_balance (the sum of all 55 seeded statement entries, money entries summing to 160.67); bonus entries 4f0d8166-bd65-46a8-85dd-b2697d98e71d (30.00, consecutive-trips offer 09edcc93-223e-4c94-945c-086a3f60dcce) and 3c8a1199-8bfe-4b08-a446-3a14912dff3f (150.00, quest 5a6e3deb-baa1-4ec9-8342-372042843970); clawback 6f77629b-4202-4871-b77e-05eeac432d6e (-150.00, reverses 3c8a1199-...); fraud debits 43f1e0b9-fc46-4180-bb18-949d4889825b (-25.13, trip 284a6aa6-...) and f0c4fc6b-a8ce-4137-9f23-0efd4dd073dc (-30.69, trip 80d25c9c-...), each naming the trip credit it reverses; instant cashout 26e4ab9b-d198-47e4-bfdd-f0e2de5f70ed (-145.00, 2026-10-08) with its 0.00 fee 79b8b581-...; rental deduction adee6148-8d09-49eb-826b-d37fe24bd4c6 (-284.46) paying rental charge 47482a84-41da-4ecf-be90-a0c7e3129a45. Excluded: the March trip 5dd4284b-... (only the safety report's subject; its pay predates the statement).
Opt-in: the upcoming guarantee d13355a9-3e4b-408d-a30a-0c1910a6556c (PHX, 2026-10-16 17:00 to 2026-10-17 03:00 MST, 240.00, 480 minutes). Excluded: the ended September guarantee a044e4c4-a6e6-4af0-a507-3264c5d86dc8 (never opted into, so it owes nothing), the quest and consecutive-trips offers (no opt-in needed). The opt-in writes source_offer_id = d13355a9-....

FACTOR CARD - earnings_ext_hold_release_payout (6: 4 parameter, 2 method; baseline: the whole available balance, nothing kept back, 160.67).
1 reserve_base_selection (method; evidence history): ladder 3+ bonus entries in 3 whole months -> the most recent bonus entry alone; 1 or 2 -> total of bonus entries less bonus clawbacks in the lookback; none -> nothing. World: 2 entries -> 30.00 + 150.00 - 150.00 = 30.00 (the most-recent method would take 150.00). Baseline -> payout 77.17.
2 reserve_rate (parameter; history): 2+ fraud disqualifications and clawbacks -> 1.0; 1 -> 0.5; none -> 0. World: 3 -> 1.0. Baseline -> 77.17.
3 trust_scale (parameter; multi-source rating AND safety reports; cross-difficulty driver): rating >= 4.90 and no safety report in 6 months -> 0.5; rating >= 4.80 and < 4.90 and none -> 0.75; otherwise 1.0. World: 4.92, the 2026-03-30 safety report a2748fe8-... is 6 whole months back (near-miss, outside) -> 0.5; reserve 15.00. Baseline -> 47.17.
4 new_account_holdback (parameter; date): open < 6 months -> 60.00; 6 to 11 -> 30.00; 12+ -> 0. World: opened 2026-02-04, 8 months -> 30.00. Baseline -> 92.17.
5 cashout_holdback_share (parameter; history): 3+ instant cashouts in the last month -> 0.2; 1 or 2 -> 0.1; none -> 0, applied to the cashouts' total. World: one 145.00 cashout -> 14.50. Baseline -> 76.67.
6 ended_rental_holdback (method; cross-difficulty rental): returned and not closed -> balance due less deposit held (floor 0); return due -> whole balance due; otherwise nothing. World: rental 77fc451e-1d25-4ef8-81d4-26c59e9bc973 returned 2026-10-12, balance_due 289.00 (unpaid weekly charge de02e210-...), deposit_held 250.00 -> 39.00. Baseline -> 101.17.
Gold: 160.67 - (15.00 + 30.00 + 14.50 + 39.00) = 62.17. All-baseline fall-back: 160.67.

FACTOR CARD - earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock (6: 5 parameter, 1 method; baseline: the stated 240.00, unchanged).
1 level_scale (parameter; cross-difficulty driver): Black/Black SUV -> 1.25; Comfort/XL -> 1.1; others 1.0. World: Comfort -> 1.1. Baseline -> 213.70.
2 quality_scale (parameter; cross-difficulty driver standing record): 2+ warnings in 6 months -> 0.85; 1 -> 0.93; none -> 1.0. World: 2026-07-22 warning 08e2c6dc-... counts; 2026-03-18 warning 25238b83-... is 6 months back (near-miss) -> 0.93. Baseline -> 247.65.
3 pro_boost (parameter; multi-source status AND quarter points AND hold state): Platinum/Diamond/Diamond Elite with >= 300 points and not on hold -> 0.08; Silver/Gold with >= 30 points and not on hold -> 0.04; otherwise 0. World at handling time: Gold, 49 points, active -> 0.04 (on the opening world, status payout_hold -> 0). Baseline -> 224.42.
4 activity_scale (parameter; history): paid trips in the last month (trip pay entries less fraud-reversed trips) < 20 -> 0.8; 20 to 59 -> 0.9; 60+ -> 1.0. World: 21 - 2 = 19 -> 0.8 (near-miss: 21 raw entries would select 0.9). Baseline -> 283.34.
5 early_career_supplement (parameter; cross-difficulty driver): < 1000 lifetime trips -> 20.00; 1000 to 2999 -> 10.00; 3000+ -> 0. World: 860 -> 20.00. Baseline -> 212.27.
6 early_optin_credit (method; date): 3+ calendar days before the window start -> flat 15.00; 1 or 2 days -> 4.00 per day; same day -> nothing. World: 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-16 = 2 days -> 8.00. Baseline -> 224.27.
Gold: 240.00 x 1.1 x 0.93 x 1.04 x 0.8 + 20.00 + 8.00 = 232.27. All-baseline fall-back: 240.00. Task-level: multi-source factors trust_scale and pro_boost; cross-difficulty factors trust_scale, ended_rental_holdback, level_scale, quality_scale, early_career_supplement.

WORLD (initial_state) AND WHY EACH ROW EXISTS. customers: the driver only (locate/verify). earnings_accounts: the held account (both computations). earnings_ledger (55): 21 trip pay + 21 Pro points entries for the October trips (activity count, points sum, balance), 5 tips, 2 bonus entries, 1 clawback, 2 fraud debits, 1 cashout + 1 fee, 1 rental deduction; the statement starts after the 2026-09-29 weekly payout that emptied the balance (the driver did not drive 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-01), so the balance and points identities hold over the seeded rows. bonus_offers (4): two guarantees (selection near-miss), the quest whose bonus was clawed back, the consecutive-trips offer. trips (22): the 21 October trips plus the March trip the safety report concerns. driver_agreements: level, rating, lifetime trips. driver_standing_events (3): two warnings (one in, one out of the window) and the safety report (out of the window, but its row is what the trust scale's count reads). rental_agreements + rental_charges (5): the returned Electric Sedan, deposit 250.00, the 2026-10-01 weekly charge paid 284.46 from earnings on 2026-10-06 and 4.54 by card on 2026-10-07, the unpaid 2026-10-08 weekly charge (the 2026-10-13 deduction was skipped because nothing is deducted during a payout hold, and the card charge follows the day after the deduction). Automatic clauses checked: no weekly payout or rental deduction during the hold (none seeded after 2026-10-09); the quest bonus posted within 3 days of its 2026-10-05 window end and was clawed back once after two of its 11 trips were disqualified, leaving 9 below the target 10; the consecutive-trips bonus (3 trips with 7- and 9-minute gaps) stands; the ended September guarantee owes nothing (no opt-in). Removing the hold row values flips the tree away; removing any factor's evidence rows changes the corresponding figure above.

PERSONA. Marisol speaks warmly and hurriedly, states only the surface goal (opt in to the Friday-night guarantee she saw, 5 pm to 3 am, $240 for eight hours), gives the phone number 6025550163 and the date of birth 1990-07-19 when asked (card 6742 only as a third detail), answers the rental question only if asked, does not know balances, points or statuses, agrees in one line if told something on the account needs sorting out, completes the opt-in herself with the amount the agent gives, may ask once why it is not $240 (a question the charter answers with no write), and ends when told she is opted in. No line names the hold, a payout or any fix.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone; verify with phone and date of birth; read the earnings account (hold, balance, status, opened date), the offers, the full statement, the agreement, the standing record, the rental and its charges, and the trips; lift the resolved hold with payout_amount 62.17 (agent); unlock the opt-in and hand it over; the driver opts in to d13355a9-3e4b-408d-a30a-0c1910a6556c with guaranteed_amount 232.27.

VERIFICATION (actual runs). /tmp/r0056/d4/calc.py replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each policy's compute with check_compute's own evaluator at handling time: hold-release payout 62.17 on the opening world (factor baselines 77.17, 77.17, 47.17, 92.17, 76.67, 101.17; all-baseline 160.67); locked guarantee 232.27 on the world after the lift (factor baselines 213.70, 247.65, 224.42, 283.34, 212.27, 224.27; all-baseline 240.00; with the lift skipped 224.42). The gate outputs are recorded in the closing entry.

PLACES MOST EASILY GOT WRONG. Computing the guarantee before lifting the hold (224.42); taking the September guarantee or the stated 240.00; counting 21 trips instead of 19; counting the March warning or safety report (outside six months); using the most recent bonus (150.00) instead of the net total (30.00) for two bonus entries; forgetting that the deposit offsets the returned rental's balance (holding back 289.00) or holding back nothing; treating the cashout fee as part of the cashout total.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT (hidden compute and gold masked). From the published rules, tool schemas, the persona's lines and the lookup returns: the opt-in rule's prerequisite sentence and the account's hold -> lift first; hold-release rule ladders over the statement, agreement, standing record and rental -> 160.67 - 15.00 - 30.00 - 14.50 - 39.00 = 62.17; opt-in rule ladders -> 232.27. The draft agrees with gold and admits no second reading: every ladder is pairwise disjoint as written and the order and rounding are stated.

REVISIONS. (1) First seed had the consecutive-trips bonus posted after the quest bonus, so the two reserve-base methods gave the same 30.00 and the method choice was untested; the consecutive-trips offer was moved to 2026-10-02 (bonus 2026-10-03) so the most-recent method now gives 150.00 against the correct 30.00; balances, the rental deduction (284.46) and the payout (62.17) were recomputed and propagated. (2) Post-hold trips lengthened so the hold-release payout stays positive after all four keep-backs.

CLOSING (per-task and difficulty gates). Gate run (repository root, DIFF=env/env_0056_ride_hailing_platform/tasks/driver_earnings_bonuses_and_payouts): check_extended -> EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (4 tools); replay_tasks -> REPLAY OK (0.json 14 actions, closure 93 = initial 93; 1.json 14 actions, closure 75 = initial 75; deterministic, non-vacuous, no Error); check_compute -> COMPUTE OK (0.json: 2 computations, 12 factors, 5 cross-difficulty, history rows 52, branches 34; 1.json: 2 computations, 9 factors, 4 cross-difficulty, history rows 18, branches 26; suite means branches 30.00, steps 14.00; history_rows_max 52, branches_max 34); check_grounding -> GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire -> SCOPE OK; check_cache_diff -> INFO only. check_solvability stops before checking any task with 'identity-verification tool verify_customer_identity must compare the match count against a determinable positive integer K': the frozen blueprint share tool counts matches with `matched += 1` and tests `matched >= 2`, while the gate only recognises `matched = sum(...)`. A scratch copy of the gate whose only change is to read K from that `matched >= 2` comparison reports SOLVABILITY OK for both tasks (0.json: 2 calls, 2 base gates, 60 seed rows; 1.json: 2 calls, 5 base gates, 48 seed rows). check_traceability is deferred until the KB is published. validate_scenario reports for this difficulty only the four 'required document ... not found' errors that rendering resolves; no frozen_time or task_tools token error.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Quintero, a Wayfare Comfort driver in Phoenix who started driving in February. It is Wednesday morning and you are calling driver support from your phone between rides. In the driver app you saw an earnings guarantee for this coming Friday night in Phoenix, running from 5 pm Friday to 3 am Saturday, that shows a $240 guarantee for eight hours online, and you want to opt in to that guarantee now, before Friday. That is the only thing you called about. You speak warmly but a bit hurriedly because you want to get back on the road.

When the agent asks how to find you, you give your mobile number, which you read out as 6025550163. When the agent asks for something more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth as 1990-07-19. You do not remember when you opened your profile and say so if asked; you give the last four digits of your card, 6742, only if the agent says it still needs another detail.

You are fine with the agent looking through your earnings account, your offers, your trips, your driver record and your recent Wayfare rental. Only if the agent asks about the rental do you say you returned the Electric Sedan on Monday because your own car is back from the shop. You do not know your balance, your Pro points or any account status, and if asked you say you have not opened the earnings tab for a few days.

If the agent tells you that something on your earnings account needs to be sorted out, or has been sorted out along the way, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead, and you do not ask for anything more about it. Once the agent tells you the guarantee you would be locked in at and hands the opt-in over to you, you complete it right away for the Friday night guarantee with exactly the amount the agent gave you, and then tell the agent you have done it. If that amount is not the $240 you saw in the app, you ask briefly why and accept the agent's explanation. When the agent confirms you are opted in, you thank them and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: The resolved negative-balance payout hold is lifted: the earnings account returns to active with hold reason none, and a hold-release payout of 62.17 is sent and booked to the earnings week starting 2026-10-12, leaving the reserve and holdbacks in the balance.

request_binding.action_semantics: The account is on a negative_balance payout hold while its available balance (160.67) is already above the negative_balance_hold_threshold (-150.00), so the hold's reason is resolved and the hold is owed a lift whatever the caller asked; the locked guarantee the caller wants is not worked out until no such hold shows on the account, and lifting a hold (with its hold-release payout) is the only write in this difficulty that takes it off. No adjacent action (an adjustment, a bonus, a cashout) changes the hold.

discriminator.business_meaning: lift a payout hold whose negative-balance reason is resolved

stage_provenance.fact: The hold is lifted and the hold-release payout is sent by this call, synchronously, on the account the lookup returned.

base_preconditions.condition: A hold is lifted only when its reason is resolved: a verified new payout destination for bank_verification_failed, the balance recovering above negative_balance_hold_threshold for negative_balance, a cleared review for fraud_review; a fraud review hold cannot last more than fraud_review_max_days and is then lifted unless the agreement has been deactivated for fraud, and a deactivation_fraud hold is lifted only if the deactivation is reversed on appeal.

gold_actions.business_effect: The driver's opt-in to the upcoming Phoenix earnings guarantee d13355a9-3e4b-408d-a30a-0c1910a6556c is recorded with the locked guarantee 232.27.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks to opt in to the Friday-night Phoenix guarantee; opting in to an earnings guarantee offer is the driver's own action and is the only write that records an opt-in, distinct from crediting a bonus or making a cashout.

edges.condition: earnings_accounts.status is active and earnings_accounts.payout_hold_reason is none whenever the hold reason on record has been resolved (for negative_balance, available_balance above negative_balance_hold_threshold).
edges.policy_source: A locked guarantee is not worked out until the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen_time the earnings account is still on payout hold with reason negative_balance although its available balance, 160.67, is above the -150.00 threshold, so a hold whose reason is resolved still shows on the account.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The hold-lifting write sets status to active and payout_hold_reason to none (and sends the 62.17 hold-release payout); the pro_boost binding then moves from 0 (on-hold tier) to 0.04, and the locked guarantee from 224.42 to 232.27.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has one prerequisite edge and no parallel branch: the hold must be off (value of pro_boost) before the locked guarantee is worked out, and the reverse order records a different guarantee (224.42), so only release-then-opt-in reaches the gold terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the hold lift leaves the account on payout_hold: no hold-release payout row of 62.17 is written, status and payout_hold_reason stay payout_hold/negative_balance, and the locked guarantee recomputes to 224.42 instead of 232.27 because the Pro boost falls to its on-hold tier (0).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the opt-in to the Friday-night guarantee; it never mentions a hold, a negative balance, a payout, a lift or anything to be fixed first. Its only related line is a passive reaction: if the agent says something on the account needs sorting out or has been sorted out, the caller says that is fine and asks nothing more.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f records the opt-in whatever the account status (it reads the account only for the customer reference and the offer only to copy its market and window), and lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01 lifts whatever hold is on the account; neither checks a balance, a hold reason or the other write, raises an error or hints.
